i.norm: Tests that {@link NodeIterator#hasNext()} is a pure (idempotent) operation: calling it repeatedly without an intervening {@link Iterator#next()} call must not advance the iterator or cause any node to be skipped.
Two sibling divs, each containing two paragraphs with text nodes.
